name: Porbandar Municipal Corporation
description: Municipal government for the City of Porbandar in Porbandar district, not the entire district. At formation it covered the former Porbandar-Chhaya Municipality and the gram panchayat areas of Vanana (Virpur), Digvijaygadh, Ratanpar and Javar. The website field points to the state corporation directory, which does not link a standalone Porbandar corporation site.
